project.name: cavet
project.description: A Go CLI security-triage tool for coding agents. It runs scanners (trivy, opengrep, gitleaks, checkov) inside an offline container engine and records every finding and decision in an append-only audit log.
project.context: This finding comes from a scan of the cavet repository itself.

finding.description:
engine/Dockerfile:111
Detected docker image with no explicit version attached. Images should be tagged with an explicit version to produce deterministic container images -- attach a version when using `FROM <image>`.
verdict: dismissed (high confidence, by operator): engine/Dockerfile:111 FROM scanners references the internal stage defined at line 74 of the same Dockerfile, not a registry image; internal stages cannot carry a version tag

mechanical_context.path_class: container image build definition (shipped as the scanner engine image)
mechanical_context.source_excerpt:
81 | # tarball, until upstream ships grpc >= 1.83.1.
   82 | COPY --from=trivy-build /out/trivy /usr/local/bin/trivy
   83 | 
   84 | # Opengrep (engine LGPL-2.1) — self-contained manylinux binary.
   85 | RUN set -e; \
   86 |     case "$TARGETARCH" in \
   87 |         amd64) oarch=manylinux_x86;      sha=58053da76672bbeb5b0a5441021c58338707052e10f81d777140ca879bd491ce ;; \
   88 |         arm64) oarch=manylinux_aarch64;  sha=96ee2caddd5f17821ae6952774a91c8781778bfa9af1ace83645444c0edc6c97 ;; \
   89 |         *) echo "unsupported TARGETARCH $TARGETARCH" >&2; exit 1 ;; \
   90 |     esac; \
   91 |     curl -fsSL -o /usr/local/bin/opengrep \
   92 |         "https://github.com/opengrep/opengrep/releases/download/v${OPENGREP_VERSION}/opengrep_${oarch}"; \
   93 |     echo "$sha /usr/local/bin/opengrep" | sha256sum -c -; \
